scope: Corollary 13 (Bounded-space halting) of the manuscript “Simulating One-Tape Time in Two-Fifths-Power Space” (preprints/Simulating-One-Tape-Time-in-Two-Fifths-Power-Space-September-25-2026/article.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 137 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 873c9e2790a66c53), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 16. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The language H is complete for DSPACE(n) under logarithmic-space many-one reductions of linear output length. If N denotes its input length, then for every fixed 0 < ϵ < 5/2, H / ∈ TIME1w,ro  N5/2−ϵ  .
